menu.what: The Open Gate setting takes over the custom firmware's Custom Shutter Sound page (mid 1592) and its switch (mid 1593): the page is renamed Open Gate and listed on MENU > Shooting > Media; both sound pages leave Shooting > Shutter/Silent; the switch keeps only itself on the page, gets a third option row and its callbacks point at og_menu.c. Its mids and option ids are the custom firmware's own, already in every native map and accepted by its id filters (supported/mapped 0x8f900a0/0x8f900b8 for 1592..1597, apply skip 0x8f900d0, option ids 5607..5630 at 0x8fa1000). compose_ap checks every old value here in v0.1.3 before writing.

groups.what: menu groups: 16-byte header {id, title, count, 0} and 30 entries {u64 mid, u64 leaf, u64 page}

pages.what: the sound page records: 'listed' is what a group entry points at, 'live' what the page map (0x8fc0a60, registrar 0x1cd148c) holds; +0x60 1, +0x64 child count, children {u64 mid, leaf} from +0x70

leaf.what: the switch's leaf (0xc0): +0x0c help, +0x54 option count, +0x58 rows (contiguous, 0x80 each)

rows.what: new: the focus switch's first row (alias 5609), moved after the other two over the listed focus page's header, which only the Shutter/Silent entry pointed at

row_fields.what: +0x00/+0x04 alias, +0x08 text, +0x10 help (= text, as native rows without help), +0x20/+0x24 images (none, as native text rows), +0x34 value, +0x74 row id

parent_pair.what: option-to-leaf pair the custom firmware registers (0x8f91c28, registrar 0x1cd1934)

profile.what: the switch's profile; +0x50 is the enabled callback (stock 'return 1' 0x1c9efbc)

relocations.what: R_AARCH64_RELATIVE entries changed in place (r_offset, addend); a symbol name is a module symbol. Entries moved to the Media slot's page field duplicate its own and leave no stale pointer behind.

retarget.what: Shutter/Silent entry 11 (1592) page -> Media entry 4 page
listed focus page +0x20, now inside the third row
listed focus page child 1596, now inside the third row
option map entry 5609 -> the third row

strings.what: 68 horizontal/vertical UXC banks: the sound page's own texts are rewritten in place (same record, NUL padded); nothing else changes
